continuously learn, adapt — and amplify human potential.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]

visualizations.]

register now.

intelligence, simulation and smart technologies, moving you from digital blueprint to real-world

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

boosting income for the local community by 60%.

## World's Most Accurate Thermal Mass Flow Meter

[640i V2]

### QuadraTherm^{®}

Patented QuadraTherm 4-Sensor Thermal Technology delivers +/- 0.5% of reading above 50% of
calibrated full scale.
* Patented no-drift DrySense™ sensor with a Lifetime Warranty
* Program new gases and gas mixtures with qMix™ in the field
* Field configurable: Pipe size, calibrated full scale, gas, units of measure
* Very low flows with high flows up to 60,000 sfpm (305 smps)

[EXPERIENCE MORE][210]

## Your Complete Scientific Flow Measurement Guide

### Sierra's NEW Scientific Full Line Catalog!

Quickly compare and select the right mass flow controllers and meters for your lab and OEM
applications with all specifications in one place.
* Full portfolio of scientific thermal mass flow controllers and meters
* Key specs, performance data, and connection options at a glance
* Deal for OEM design-in, gas delivery, and high-precision lab systems

[DOWNLOAD CATALOG][211]
[Full-line Scientific catalog for precision mass flow meters and controllers]

## Rock Solid Reliability & Repeatability.

### RedySmart^{®}

Proven Thermal Mass Flow Meters and Controllers with Stable MEMS Technology

#### Highlights
* Up to ±0.3% full scale plus ±0.5% of reading
* Up to 10 gases or gas mixes
* Repeatability: Better than ±0.2% full scale
* Long-term stability, 100:1 turndown
* Modular — connect up to eight MFCs on a single manifold

[EXPERIENCE MORE][212]
[RedySmart thermal mass flow meter with no-drift sensor warranty]

## Precision Flow Measurement Solutions for Industry.

### Sierra's Complete Flow Products Catalog and Guide

Explore Sierra's complete range of flow meters for gas, liquid, and steam in a single, easy-to-use
selection guide.
* Search by technology: thermal, vortex, or ultrasonic
* Compare flow range, accuracy, and repeatability by model
* New application optimizers simplify sizing and product selection

## World's Most Accurate Thermal Mass Flow Meter

[640i V2]

### QuadraTherm^{®}

Patented QuadraTherm 4-Sensor Thermal Technology delivers +/- 0.5% of reading above 50% of
calibrated full scale.
* Patented no-drift DrySense™ sensor with a Lifetime Warranty
* Program new gases and gas mixtures with qMix™ in the field
* Field configurable: Pipe size, calibrated full scale, gas, units of measure
* Very low flows with high flows up to 60,000 sfpm (305 smps)

[EXPERIENCE MORE][210]

## Your Complete Scientific Flow Measurement Guide

### Sierra's NEW Scientific Full Line Catalog!

Quickly compare and select the right mass flow controllers and meters for your lab and OEM
applications with all specifications in one place.

* Deal for OEM design-in, gas delivery, and high-precision lab systems

* Up to ±0.3% full scale plus ±0.5% of reading

* Long-term stability, 100:1 turndown
* Modular — connect up to eight MFCs on a single manifold

## 24/7 Property Restoration Services

We’re available to help with all your emergency mold, fire, and water restoration needs. Our company
provides **free estimates** and our technicians are **available 24/7**. 

We are the go-to company for flood cleanup and emergency restoration. If your house is flooded and

[ Get a Free Estimate ][46]
[water on hardwood floor before restoration]

### Need Help With a Busted Pipe?

## Water Restoration

We take care of the entire water damage problem. That includes cleaning things up, getting
everything dry, and communicating with your insurance so you get the maximum benefit from them.

All of our technicians are certified through the IICRC and we put them through extensive training
before they ever step foot in your house. We use the latest equipment and keep it extremely clean.

Estimates are free and we’ll never pressure you into using our company. We have 5-star reviews
across every platform. We can arrive at your property in 30 minutes or less. Call us now!
* Emergency water extraction
* Water overflow cleanup
* Leaking pipe drying
* Toilet backup cleaning
* Roof leak cleanup
* Dishwasher leak drying
* We'll get any area dry!

[ Water Damage Restoration ][47]

### Need Mold Remediated?

## Mold Remediation

We thoroughly remediate mold wherever it’s not wanted. Our team starts with air filtration and
containment, then removes any materials that can’t be saved, cleans the area with effective cleaning
agents, and uses micro-filtered vacuums on every inch of the area.

All of our technicians who handle these jobs are licensed for mold remediation in the state of
Texas. We also use the best equipment available and keep it exceptionally clean.

We’ve worked with all of the mold inspection and testing companies in Austin and are experienced in
following their protocols. Call us to get your mold issue taken care of safely and effectively.
* Quarantine mold sterilization
* Mold disinfecting on walls, floors, and ceilings
* Removing mold in attics
* Carpet mold extraction
* Mold cleaning in bathrooms
* Licensed to perform mold protocols
* And we can take care of just about any interior mold!

[ Mold Removal Services ][48]
[large area of mold in bathroom]
[House needing a fire restoration company in Austin]

### Need Fire Damage Cleaned Up?

## Fire Restoration Company

We secure the site, remove debris, clean smoke and soot from surfaces and contents, neutralize odor,
dry any water used to put out the fire, and coordinate the details with your insurance company.

Our crews include IICRC-certified technicians who follow established standards. We’re licensed and
insured, use proven cleaning agents and HEPA filtration, and document every step with photos,
moisture readings, and clear scopes. We also work directly with insurance adjusters to keep your
claim moving along.

We do whatever we can to salvage your belongings, and we fully document everything that can’t be
saved. Estimates are honest and itemized, updates are steady, and you get practical help with the
insurance process to cut delays. If you’re dealing with a fire loss right now, give us a call and
we’ll be there within 30 minutes.
* Kitchen fires
* Accidental fires
* Whole-house fires
* Lightning strike fires
* Mechanical fires
* Smoke damage
* And nearly any kind of fire!

[ Fire Damage Restoration ][49]

### Need Biohazard Services?

## Biohazard Cleanup Services

We handle biohazard cleanup discreetly and professionally. That means securing the area, setting
containment, removing and disposing of contaminated materials, disinfecting surfaces, and cleaning
the air with HEPA filtration. Every step follows industry standards for bloodborne pathogens and
hazardous waste handling.

We use EPA-registered disinfectants, maintain strict chain-of-custody for waste, and coordinate
approved transport and disposal. Photos, readings, and progress notes are logged throughout the
entirety of the project.

Estimates are clear and pressure-free, arrival is typically within 30 minutes, and we stay available
for follow-up if an adjuster needs more detail.
* Animal infestation cleanup
* Sewage backup cleaning
* Crime scene cleanup
* Chemical spill cleaning
* Neglected property restoration
* Blood and bodily fluid cleaning
* And most biohazard situations!

[ Biohazard Cleanup ][50]
[Biohazard cleanup workers in protective suits sanitizing a residential room]

## We Offer Free Estimates

Our inspections and estimates are free of charge, with few exceptions, to give you a decent idea of
the cost and timeline of the project. We’re here to help you get back to normal with as few
headaches as possible!

[ Schedule Appointment ][51]
[All Nation Restoration technician working in Austin TX]

### WHY CHOOSE ALL NATION Restoration?

### Restoring Homes With Care and Speed

We will always deliver well-trained technicians, the best equipment, the best tools, and the best
products the damage restoration industry has available. We’re an IICRC-certified company.

At All Nation Restoration, our customers come first. You can be sure to have a great experience with
us.

Highly-Rated

We're highly rated with over 500 5-star reviews from our customers!

Experienced

We have 15+ years of experience in the damage restoration industry.

IICRC-Certified

All Nation Restoration is an IICRC-certified company!

24/7 Support

Our team is always here to help 24/7 with emergency services!

### How We Beat Other Restoration Companies in Austin

#### We're the Team That's Got Your Back

We’re not a faceless franchise. We’re real people who live and work right here in Texas. Restoration
pros, problem solvers, and neighbors you can count on. 

We take our work seriously because we know how much it can affect people’s lives. Our team will be
with you throughout the whole process for whatever you need.

All of our employees are IICRC-certified, background checked, and trained to handle every job with
care, speed, and attention to detail. You do not just get a service. You get a crew that treats your
home like it’s their own.

## 24/7 Property Restoration Services

We’re available to help with all your emergency mold, fire, and water restoration needs. Our company
provides **free estimates** and our technicians are **available 24/7**. 

We are the go-to company for flood cleanup and emergency restoration. If your house is flooded and
you need water extraction, give us a call or fill out our contact form to get started.

[ Get a Free Estimate ][46]
[water on hardwood floor before restoration]

### Need Help With a Busted Pipe?

## Water Restoration

We take care of the entire water damage problem. That includes cleaning things up, getting
everything dry, and communicating with your insurance so you get the maximum benefit from them.

All of our technicians are certified through the IICRC and we put them through extensive training
before they ever step foot in your house. We use the latest equipment and keep it extremely clean.

Estimates are free and we’ll never pressure you into using our company. We have 5-star reviews
across every platform. We can arrive at your property in 30 minutes or less. Call us now!
* Emergency water extraction
* Water overflow cleanup
* Leaking pipe drying
* Toilet backup cleaning
* Roof leak cleanup
* Dishwasher leak drying
* We'll get any area dry!

[ Water Damage Restoration ][47]

### Need Mold Remediated?

## Mold Remediation

We thoroughly remediate mold wherever it’s not wanted. Our team starts with air filtration and
containment, then removes any materials that can’t be saved, cleans the area with effective cleaning
agents, and uses micro-filtered vacuums on every inch of the area.

All of our technicians who handle these jobs are licensed for mold remediation in the state of
Texas. We also use the best equipment available and keep it exceptionally clean.

We’ve worked with all of the mold inspection and testing companies in Austin and are experienced in
following their protocols. Call us to get your mold issue taken care of safely and effectively.
* Quarantine mold sterilization
* Mold disinfecting on walls, floors, and ceilings
* Removing mold in attics
* Carpet mold extraction
* Mold cleaning in bathrooms
* Licensed to perform mold protocols
* And we can take care of just about any interior mold!

[ Mold Removal Services ][48]
[large area of mold in bathroom]
[House needing a fire restoration company in Austin]

### Need Fire Damage Cleaned Up?

## Fire Restoration Company

We secure the site, remove debris, clean smoke and soot from surfaces and contents, neutralize odor,
dry any water used to put out the fire, and coordinate the details with your insurance company.

Our crews include IICRC-certified technicians who follow established standards. We’re licensed and
insured, use proven cleaning agents and HEPA filtration, and document every step with photos,
moisture readings, and clear scopes. We also work directly with insurance adjusters to keep your
claim moving along.

We do whatever we can to salvage your belongings, and we fully document everything that can’t be
saved. Estimates are honest and itemized, updates are steady, and you get practical help with the
insurance process to cut delays. If you’re dealing with a fire loss right now, give us a call and
we’ll be there within 30 minutes.
* Kitchen fires
* Accidental fires
* Whole-house fires
* Lightning strike fires
* Mechanical fires
* Smoke damage
* And nearly any kind of fire!

[ Fire Damage Restoration ][49]

### Need Biohazard Services?

## Biohazard Cleanup Services

We handle biohazard cleanup discreetly and professionally. That means securing the area, setting
containment, removing and disposing of contaminated materials, disinfecting surfaces, and cleaning
the air with HEPA filtration. Every step follows industry standards for bloodborne pathogens and
hazardous waste handling.

We use EPA-registered disinfectants, maintain strict chain-of-custody for waste, and coordinate
approved transport and disposal. Photos, readings, and progress notes are logged throughout the
entirety of the project.

Estimates are clear and pressure-free, arrival is typically within 30 minutes, and we stay available
for follow-up if an adjuster needs more detail.
* Animal infestation cleanup
* Sewage backup cleaning
* Crime scene cleanup
* Chemical spill cleaning
* Neglected property restoration
* Blood and bodily fluid cleaning
* And most biohazard situations!

[ Biohazard Cleanup ][50]
[Biohazard cleanup workers in protective suits sanitizing a residential room]

## We Offer Free Estimates

Our inspections and estimates are free of charge, with few exceptions, to give you a decent idea of
the cost and timeline of the project. We’re here to help you get back to normal with as few
headaches as possible!

[ Schedule Appointment ][51]

### WHY CHOOSE ALL NATION Restoration?

### Restoring Homes With Care and Speed

We will always deliver well-trained technicians, the best equipment, the best tools, and the best
products the damage restoration industry has available. We’re an IICRC-certified company.

At All Nation Restoration, our customers come first. You can be sure to have a great experience with
us.

Highly-Rated

We're highly rated with over 500 5-star reviews from our customers!

Experienced

We have 15+ years of experience in the damage restoration industry.

IICRC-Certified

All Nation Restoration is an IICRC-certified company!

24/7 Support

Our team is always here to help 24/7 with emergency services!

### How We Beat Other Restoration Companies in Austin

#### We're the Team That's Got Your Back

We’re not a faceless franchise. We’re real people who live and work right here in Texas. Restoration
pros, problem solvers, and neighbors you can count on. 

We take our work seriously because we know how much it can affect people’s lives. Our team will be
with you throughout the whole process for whatever you need.

All of our employees are IICRC-certified, background checked, and trained to handle every job with
care, speed, and attention to detail. You do not just get a service. You get a crew that treats your
home like it’s their own.

# Устройства для цифровой фабрики и индустриального интернета вещей

Компоненты систем беспроводной промышленной автоматизации

## Датчики беспроводные

Датчики обеспечивают:
* измерение физических величин
* контроль выхода полученных значений за заданные пользователем уставки
* обмен данными с другими устройствами по беспроводным защищенным каналам дальней и ближней связи
* длительную автономную работу от встроенного источника питания.

Линейка выпускаемых датчиков включает:
* [Амперметр][38] для бесконтактного измерения силы тока
* [Виброметр][39] для измерения параметров вибрации и температуры
* [Газоанализатор][40] для определения процентного содержания выбранного газа
* [Дальномер-уровнемер][41] для измерения расстояний и уровней
* [Сигнализатор][42] для контроля дискретных процессов
* [Термометр][43] для измерения температуры
* [Термоманометр ][44]для измерения и регистрации давления и температуры

[Подробнее…][45]
[Автон Профи — многофункциональный карманный компьютер]
[Полевые устройства Автон]

## Полевые устройства

Полевые устройства предназначены для подключения проводных и беспроводных датчиков к различным
системам сбора и передачи данных.

Доступны следующие устройства:
* [Шлюз][46] для интеграции беспроводных датчиков «Автон» и проводных датчиков сторонних
  производителей в беспроводные системы передачи данных
* [Шлюз автономный][47] для интеграции беспроводных датчиков «Автон» в беспроводные системы передачи
  данных дальнего радиуса действия в условиях отсутствия внешнего питания
* [Радиоинтерфейс][48] для интеграции беспроводных датчиков «Автон» в сторонние системы
* [Блок питания][49] для обеспечения питанием проводных устройств

[Подробнее…][50]

## Датчики для нефтедобычи

Датчики обеспечивают:
* измерение физических величин
* долговременное хранение измеренных значений
* обмен данными с другими устройствами по беспроводному защищенному каналу ближней связи
* длительную автономную работу от встроенного источника питания.

Линейка выпускаемых датчиков включает:
* [Эхолот][51] и [эхолот моноблочный][52] для определения уровня жидкости и давления в затрубном
  пространстве скважины
* Эхолот автоматический для определения уровня жидкости и давления в затрубном пространстве скважины
  без участия оператора
* [Динамограф накладной][53] и [межтраверсный][54] для контроля параметров штанговых
  глубинно-насосных установок
* [Термоманометр регистратор устьевой][55] для измерения и долговременного хранения значений
  давления и температуры на устье добывающей или нагнетательной скважины
* [Термоманометр регистратор погружной][56] для измерения и долговременного хранения давления,
  температуры и относительной электрической проводимости в стволе скважины

[Подробнее…][57]
[Датчики для нефтедобычи]
[Комплексы для нефтедобычи]

## Комплексы для нефтедобычи

Позволяют проводить полный цикл различных видов исследований скважин, включая проведение измерений,
передачу данных, обработку результатов, формирование отчетов и ведение нормативно-справочной
информации.

Представляют набор программных и аппаратных средств:
* [Автон Уровень][58] для исследования текущего значения уровня жидкости в затрубном пространстве
* [Автон КВУ][59] для долговременного исследования изменения уровня жидкости, вывода скважины на
  режим
* [Автон ШГН][60] для исследования текущего состояния штанговых глубинно-насосных установок
* [Автон Уровень ШГН][61] для проведения комплексных исследований скважин

[Подробнее…][62]

## Операторские устройства

Представляют собой устройства, при помощи которых оператор взаимодействует с устройствами «Автон» в
полевых условиях:
* изменяет режим работы устройств
* проводит измерение и анализирует результаты исследований
* хранит результаты исследо

# Устройства для цифровой фабрики и индустриального интернета вещей

Компоненты систем беспроводной промышленной автоматизации

## Датчики беспроводные

Датчики обеспечивают:
* измерение физических величин
* контроль выхода полученных значений за заданные пользователем уставки
* обмен данными с другими устройствами по беспроводным защищенным каналам дальней и ближней связи
* длительную автономную работу от встроенного источника питания.

Линейка выпускаемых датчиков включает:
* [Амперметр][38] для бесконтактного измерения силы тока
* [Виброметр][39] для измерения параметров вибрации и температуры
* [Газоанализатор][40] для определения процентного содержания выбранного газа
* [Дальномер-уровнемер][41] для измерения расстояний и уровней
* [Сигнализатор][42] для контроля дискретных процессов
* [Термометр][43] для измерения температуры
* [Термоманометр ][44]для измерения и регистрации давления и температуры

Доступны следующие устройства:
* [Шлюз][46] для интеграции беспроводных датчиков «Автон» и проводных датчиков сторонних
  производителей в беспроводные системы передачи данных
* [Шлюз автономный][47] для интеграции беспроводных датчиков «Автон» в беспроводные системы передачи

* [Радиоинтерфейс][48] для интеграции беспроводных датчиков «Автон» в сторонние системы
* [Блок питания][49] для обеспечения питанием проводных устройств

## Датчики для нефтедобычи

Датчики обеспечивают:
* измерение физических величин
* долговременное хранение измеренных значений
* обмен данными с другими устройствами по беспроводному защищенному каналу ближней связи
* длительную автономную работу от встроенного источника питания.

Линейка выпускаемых датчиков включает:
* [Эхолот][51] и [эхолот моноблочный][52] для определения уровня жидкости и давления в затрубном
  пространстве скважины
* Эхолот автоматический для определения уровня жидкости и давления в затрубном пространстве скважины
  без участия оператора
* [Динамограф накладной][53] и [межтраверсный][54] для контроля параметров штанговых
  глубинно-насосных установок
* [Термоманометр регистратор устьевой][55] для измерения и долговременного хранения значений
  давления и температуры на устье добывающей или нагнетательной скважины
* [Термоманометр регистратор погружной][56] для измерения и долговременного хранения давления,
  температуры и относительной электрической проводимости в стволе скважины

## Комплексы для нефтедобычи

Позволяют проводить полный цикл различных видов исследований скважин, включая проведение измерений,
передачу данных, обработку результатов, формирование отчетов и ведение нормативно-справочной
информации.

Представляют набор программных и аппаратных средств:
* [Автон Уровень][58] для исследования текущего значения уровня жидкости в затрубном пространстве
* [Автон КВУ][59] для долговременного исследования изменения уровня жидкости, вывода скважины на
  режим
* [Автон ШГН][60] для исследования текущего состояния штанговых глубинно-насосных установок
* [Автон Уровень ШГН][61] для проведения комплексных исследований скважин

## Операторские устройства

Представляют собой устройства, при помощи которых оператор взаимодействует с устройствами «Автон» в
полевых условиях:
* изменяет режим работы устройств
* проводит измерение и анализирует результаты исследований
* хранит результаты исследований и передает их в информационную систему
* проводит оперативную проверку работоспособности устройств систем мониторинга
* выполняет вспомогательные функции.
Выпускаются устройства:
* [Автон Профи][63] — многофункциональный карманный компьютер индустриального исполнения, оснащенный
  каналом передачи данных по сетям GPRS
* [Автон Мобил][64] — смартфон защищенного исполнения

## Программное обеспечение

Предназначено для проведения измерений, обработки и хранения результатов исследований, ведения
нормативно-справочной информации.

Включает:
* «Автон-Мастер» для ведения базы данных, обработки результатов исследований, формирования отчетов и
  обмена со смежными системами на персональном компьютере
* «Автон-Оператор» для управления устройствами «Автон» посредством операторских устройств [Профи
  ][65]или [Мобил][66].

## Способы применения

Использование продуктов «Автон», в рамках промышленного интернета вещей, позволяет удаленно
контролировать и управлять технологическими процессами, в том числе без участия человека. Продукты
«Автон» могут использоваться в системах различной архитектуры.

### Кратковременные исследования

Проводятся для оценки состояния оборудования и технологических процессов силами оператора,
использующего комплексы «Автон». Используя операторские устройства «Автон», оператор выполняет
измерения и, либо непосредственно с места проведения измерений (по каналам дальней связи), либо при
возвращении в офис (по каналам ближней связи), передает полученные данные в информационную систему.
[Схема исследования для оценки состояния оборудования и технологических процессов]

### Длительные исследования без участия человека

При необходимости проведения длительных исследований состояния оборудования и технологических
процессов участие человека становится невозможным или неэффективным. В этом случае оператор
заменяется автономным шлюзом «Автон», не требующим внешнего питания и способным в течение
длительного времени выполнять функции проведения измерений и отправки данных в информационную
систему вместо человека.
[Схема исследования для оценки состояния оборудования и технологических процессов 4]

### Локальные системы автоматизации

Для организации систем локального автоматического управления датчики «Автон» могут выступать в
качестве источников данных, проводящих измерения и передающих результаты в систему управления.
[Схема исследования для оценки состояния оборудования и технологических процессов 3]

### Постоянный мониторинг

В таких системах реализуется постоянный удаленный контроль и управление технологическими процессами
с использованием как датчиков «Автон», так и имеющихся проводных датчиков других производителей.
Таким образом реализуется концепция умного предприятия (Smart Factory), итогом которой становится
рост бизнеса и увеличение эффективности деятельности предприятия.
[Схема исследования для оценки состояния оборудования и технологических процессов 2]

## Датчики беспроводные

Датчики обеспечивают:
* измерение физических величин
* контроль выхода полученных значений за заданные пользователем уставки
* обмен данными с другими устройствами по беспроводным защищенным каналам дальней и ближней связи
* длительную автономную работу от встроенного источника питания.

Линейка выпускаемых датчиков включает:
* [Амперметр][38] для бесконтактного измерения силы тока
* [Виброметр][39] для измерения параметров вибрации и температуры
* [Газоанализатор][40] для определения процентного содержания выбранного газа
* [Дальномер-уровнемер][41] для измерения расстояний и уровней
* [Сигнализатор][42] для контроля дискретных процессов
* [Термометр][43] для измерения температуры
* [Термоманометр ][44]для измерения и регистрации давления и температуры

## Операторские устройства

Представляют собой устройства, при помощи которых оператор взаимодействует с устройствами «Автон» в

## Программное обеспечение

Предназначено для проведения измерений, обработки и хранения результатов исследований, ведения
нормативно-справочной информации.

Включает:
* «Автон-Мастер» для ведения базы данных, обработки результатов исследований, формирования отчетов и
  обмена со смежными системами на персональном компьютере
* «Автон-Оператор» для управления устройствами «Автон» посредством операторских устройств [Профи
  ][65]или [Мобил][66].

## Способы применения

Использование продуктов «Автон», в рамках промышленного интернета вещей, позволяет удаленно
контролировать и управлять технологическими процессами, в том числе без участия человека. Продукты
«Автон» могут использоваться в системах различной архитектуры.

### Кратковременные исследования

Проводятся для оценки состояния оборудования и технологических процессов силами оператора,
использующего комплексы «Автон». Используя операторские устройства «Автон», оператор выполняет
измерения и, либо непосредственно с места проведения измерений (по каналам дальней связи), либо при
возвращении в офис (по каналам ближней связи), передает полученные данные в информационную систему.
[Схема исследования для оценки состояния оборудования и технологических процессов]

### Длительные исследования без участия человека

При необходимости проведения длительных исследований состояния оборудования и технологических
процессов участие человека становится невозможным или неэффективным. В этом случае оператор
заменяется автономным шлюзом «Автон», не требующим внешнего питания и способным в течение
длительного времени выполнять функции проведения измерений и отправки данных в информационную
систему вместо человека.
[Схема исследования для оценки состояния оборудования и технологических процессов 4]

### Локальные системы автоматизации

Для организации систем локального автоматического управления датчики «Автон» могут выступать в
качестве источников данных, проводящих измерения и передающих результаты в систему управления.
[Схема исследования для оценки состояния оборудования и технологических процессов 3]

### Постоянный мониторинг

В таких системах реализуется постоянный удаленный контроль и управление технологическими процессами
с использованием как датчиков «Автон», так и имеющихся проводных датчиков других производителей.
Таким образом реализуется концепция умного предприятия (Smart Factory), итогом которой становится
рост бизнеса и увеличение эффективности деятельности предприятия.
[Схема исследования для оценки состояния оборудования и технологических процессов 2]

emergency plumbers will stop the leak and immediately start cleaning up using our advanced water

as good as new.

permanent and affordable solutions with less mess.

## Weather stations and monitoring systems for climate meteorology

Organizations around the world rely on Campbell Scientific for accurate, rugged, scalable, and
reliable measurements in environments where failure is not an option. Our systems are built to
perform in harsh conditions, adapt to evolving technologies, and scale with your needs over time.

From advancing scientific research to improving operational efficiency and safety, we provide
flexible, field-proven solutions designed to support your mission today and in the future.

[Discover Environmental Solutions][23]
[Infrastructure Solutions][24]

## Data acquisition systems for reliable, stand-alone monitoring

Campbell Scientific's high-capacity data acquisition systems (DAQ) are crafted from more than 50
years of experience designing and manufacturing monitoring solutions for dams, mining, structural
health, and other geotechnical applications. Built to turn complex environmental challenges into
clear, dependable insight, these DAQs help shape safer, smarter monitoring systems in some of the
world's harshest and most demanding conditions.

Recognized globally for precision and resilience, Campbell Scientific data loggers and DAQs are
engineered for critical applications where confidence is essential and lives often depend on
performance. With intuitive interfaces, streamlined setup, and proven long-term reliability, they
empower geotechnical service providers to build monitoring systems that endure, adapt, and perform
with purpose.

[Discover Infrastructure Solutions][25]
[Renewable Energy Solutions][26]

## Practical monitoring solutions for solar and wind projects

Campbell Scientific supports renewable energy projects with practical monitoring solutions for solar
and wind. We help teams reduce complexity with standardized stations, integration-ready sensors,
accessories, replacement parts, and experienced guidance from specification through long-term
operation.

temperature alarm systems, preventing serious damage to buildings and sensitive equipment. We are

# Intelligente Monitoring Systeme & Alarm Server

Unsere Monitoring Systeme und Alarm Server ermöglichen die lückenlose Kontrolle wichtiger Faktoren
wie Temperatur, Luftfeuchtigkeit, Rauch, Einbruch, Wasseraustritt, Sabotage und Stromspannung. Dank
intelligenter Sensoren werden Abweichungen sofort erkannt und Sie erhalten automatische
Benachrichtigungen per E-Mail, SMS oder SNMP-Trap.

## IT-Monitoring und Infrastruktur Monitoring aus einer Hand

Im Didactum® Online-Shop finden Unternehmen und öffentliche Einrichtungen professionelle Monitoring
Hardware für die ganzheitliche Überwachung von IT-Infrastruktur, Umweltbedingungen und Sicherheit.
Unsere Lösungen sind modular erweiterbar und lassen sich flexibel an Ihre individuellen
Anforderungen anpassen. Ob Serverraum-Überwachung, Temperaturüberwachung im Lager oder
Zutrittskontrolle für sensible Bereiche – mit einem Didactum Monitoring System behalten Sie stets
den Überblick.

## Sicherheit durch moderne Monitoring Systeme

Setzen Sie auf moderne Monitoring Systeme, um Ausfälle, Störungen und Sicherheitsvorfälle frühzeitig
zu erkennen und zu vermeiden. Unsere Experten beraten Sie gerne bei der Planung und Realisierung
Ihres individuellen Monitoring Systems – von der Auswahl der passenden Sensoren bis zur Integration
in Ihre bestehende IT-Landschaft.

## Ihre Vorteile im Überblick
* ✓
  **Echtzeit-Alarmierung:**
  Sofortige Benachrichtigung bei Temperaturanstieg, Wasseraustritt oder Einbruch.
* ✓
  **Modulare Sensoren:**
  Flexible Erweiterung mit Temperatur-, Feuchte-, Rauch- und Bewegungssensoren.
* ✓
  **Einfache Integration:**
  Nahtlose Einbindung in Ihre IT- und Gebäudetechnik.
* ✓
  **24/7 Überwachung:**
  Rund um die Uhr Kontrolle Ihrer kritischen Infrastruktur.

### Eigenständige Systeme

Stand-alone Betrieb ohne zusätzliche Software erforderlich.

### Flexible Integration

Kompatibel mit SNMP, Nagios, Zabbix, PRTG u. v. m.

### Modular erweiterbar

Individuelle Anpassung durch vielfältige Sensoren.

### Branchenübergreifend

Für Unternehmen, Behörden und öffentliche Einrichtungen geeignet.

## Schützen Sie Ihre Infrastruktur vor Umwelteinflüssen & unbefugtem Zugriff

### Unsere Monitoring-Systeme warnen bei:
* Temperaturanstieg oder -abfall
* Luftfeuchtigkeitsschwankungen
* Wasserleckagen und Überschwemmungen
* Stromausfällen und Spannungsschwankungen
* Rauchentwicklung und Brandgefahr
* Unbefugtem Zutritt oder Manipulation
* Fehlern oder Ausfall von Lüftungs- und Klimaanlagen
* Luftqualitätsveränderungen (z.B. CO₂-Anstieg)
* Bewegungen im überwachten Bereich

# Intelligente Monitoring Systeme & Alarm Server

Unsere Monitoring Systeme und Alarm Server ermöglichen die lückenlose Kontrolle wichtiger Faktoren
wie Temperatur, Luftfeuchtigkeit, Rauch, Einbruch, Wasseraustritt, Sabotage und Stromspannung. Dank
intelligenter Sensoren werden Abweichungen sofort erkannt und Sie erhalten automatische
Benachrichtigungen per E-Mail, SMS oder SNMP-Trap.

## IT-Monitoring und Infrastruktur Monitoring aus einer Hand

Im Didactum® Online-Shop finden Unternehmen und öffentliche Einrichtungen professionelle Monitoring
Hardware für die ganzheitliche Überwachung von IT-Infrastruktur, Umweltbedingungen und Sicherheit.
Unsere Lösungen sind modular erweiterbar und lassen sich flexibel an Ihre individuellen
Anforderungen anpassen. Ob Serverraum-Überwachung, Temperaturüberwachung im Lager oder
Zutrittskontrolle für sensible Bereiche – mit einem Didactum Monitoring System behalten Sie stets
den Überblick.

## Sicherheit durch moderne Monitoring Systeme

Setzen Sie auf moderne Monitoring Systeme, um Ausfälle, Störungen und Sicherheitsvorfälle frühzeitig
zu erkennen und zu vermeiden. Unsere Experten beraten Sie gerne bei der Planung und Realisierung
Ihres individuellen Monitoring Systems – von der Auswahl der passenden Sensoren bis zur Integration
in Ihre bestehende IT-Landschaft.

## Ihre Vorteile im Überblick
* ✓
  **Echtzeit-Alarmierung:**
  Sofortige Benachrichtigung bei Temperaturanstieg, Wasseraustritt oder Einbruch.
* ✓
  **Modulare Sensoren:**
  Flexible Erweiterung mit Temperatur-, Feuchte-, Rauch- und Bewegungssensoren.
* ✓
  **Einfache Integration:**
  Nahtlose Einbindung in Ihre IT- und Gebäudetechnik.
* ✓
  **24/7 Überwachung:**
  Rund um die Uhr Kontrolle Ihrer kritischen Infrastruktur.

### Eigenständige Systeme

Stand-alone Betrieb ohne zusätzliche Software erforderlich.

### Flexible Integration

Kompatibel mit SNMP, Nagios, Zabbix, PRTG u. v. m.

### Modular erweiterbar

Individuelle Anpassung durch vielfältige Sensoren.

### Branchenübergreifend

Für Unternehmen, Behörden und öffentliche Einrichtungen geeignet.

## Schützen Sie Ihre Infrastruktur vor Umwelteinflüssen & unbefugtem Zugriff

### Unsere Monitoring-Systeme warnen bei:
* Temperaturanstieg oder -abfall
* Luftfeuchtigkeitsschwankungen
* Wasserleckagen und Überschwemmungen
* Stromausfällen und Spannungsschwankungen
* Rauchentwicklung und Brandgefahr
* Unbefugtem Zutritt oder Manipulation
* Fehlern oder Ausfall von Lüftungs- und Klimaanlagen
* Luftqualitätsveränderungen (z.B. CO₂-Anstieg)
* Bewegungen im überwachten Bereich

## ABOUT ESA

Established in 1948, the Electronic Security Association is the largest trade association in the
United States representing the electronic security and life safety industry.

Member companies install, integrate and monitor intrusion and fire detection, video surveillance and
electronic access control systems for commercial, residential, industrial and governmental clients.
The association provides technical and management training, government advocacy and delivers
information, advice, tools, and services that members use to grow their businesses and prosper.

Together, member companies employ more than 500,000 industry professionals and serve more than 34
million residential and commercial clients.

# NOT AN ESA **MEMBER YET?**

Discover the benefits of ESA membership for your business today!

[Discover Member Benefits][64]

## ABOUT ESA

Established in 1948, the Electronic Security Association is the largest trade association in the
United States representing the electronic security and life safety industry.

Member companies install, integrate and monitor intrusion and fire detection, video surveillance and
electronic access control systems for commercial, residential, industrial and governmental clients.
The association provides technical and management training, government advocacy and delivers
information, advice, tools, and services that members use to grow their businesses and prosper.

Together, member companies employ more than 500,000 industry professionals and serve more than 34
million residential and commercial clients.

weather, satellites and our affordable sensors, you get a complete view of your fields. Any time,

[3 logos homepage website 3]

[digital farming]

###### Easy-to-use platform

Data from scouting, weather, satellites and sensors comes together on one platform for a complete
overview of your fields.

[digital farming]

###### Affordable in-field sensors

Eight times more affordable than competitors, allowing mass deployment for more and accurate
information

[digital farming ]

###### Effortless API integration

The API easily connects our data and your existing systems for a smooth and easy data transfer
process

## Multiple Data Sources

### Valuable Insights collected 24/7

[icn 6]

##### Sensor

Network of low-cost soil sensors

[icn 11]

##### Field scouting

Up-to-date digital journal of your fields

[icn]

##### Satellite

Monitor large or remote areas

[icn 9]

##### Weather

Supplementary public weather data

[icn 2]

##### Soil

Type, temperature, texture and moisture

[icn 1]

##### Crop

Cultivation plans and overview

[precision farming]

### See critical field information on one central hub

Get quick access to the insights you need to optimise your farming operation. Our Farm21 dashboard
brings data from scouting, weather, satellite, crop and sensor information together – All in one
place.

[Learn More about our platform][38]

### Interpret data easily through our user-friendly interface

Optimise your day-to-day operations with data-driven decisions. A 360-degree view of your fields and
crops helps you to set irrigation, disease control and workforce priorities.

[Check out our solution][39]
[Farm21 sensor]

## Let’s grow together!

We’re providing an agri-data solution for growers, researchers, crop advisors and distributors:
* ##### “Essential for all crop advisors
  ##### and agri-consultants”
  
  > The Farm21 platform makes it easy for our crop and sales consultants to assist farmers remotely,
  > and at scale.  We’ve seen increased customer loyalty and higher customer retention.
  
  [Untitled design 14]
  André van der Weijde
  Commercial director CAV
* ##### “The affordable and effortless
  ##### agri-data solution”
  
  > We see first-hand how Farm21’s affordable soil sensors, along with their precision farming
  > platform, help our growers to make the transition to precise farming with ease and at minimal
  > investment.
  
  [Untitled design 13]
  Ko Francke
  CO-CEO CZAV
* ##### “I could act proactively
  ##### to prevent crop damage”
  
  > Thanks to the sensor, we have noticed that the air temperature at crop height can quickly warm
  > up to 15 degrees while the air temperature at 1,5m still indicates 12 to 13 degrees.
  
  [tulips 2022 04 22 12 58 40 utc]
  Pascal Alkemande
  Flower Grower

## Our sensors are affordable, robust, and easy to install.

With costs far lower than competing products, our soil moisture probes can be deployed at scale to
deliver more insights than ever before. Measuring up to 7 values with the default configuration, the
FS31 provides the most bang for buck on the market.

Designed from scratch by our product and hardware engineers for global operation and to withstand a
harsh outdoor environment.

[More about Our sensors][40][Visit Our Online Store][41]
[FS31 stand alone small 1]

## Farm21’s Sensor Advantages

[Group 107]

##### Robust Hardware

Treat, spray & irrigate crops with sensors in place

[Group 106 5]

##### Long Lasting

Recharge battery with USB-C to last a full year on a single charge

[Growers]

### How can I achieve higher yields?

By maintaining optimal growing conditions, whatever the crop, season, climate, or soil conditions.

With Farm21 you can:
* Predict possible problems 
* Prioritise actions
* Prevent crop stress
* Receive real-time field data 24/7

### How do I operate more sustainably without compromising on yield?

By making localised decisions about insects, fungi, water and cultivation and plan precisely for
labour and resources.

With Farm21 you can:
* Determine exactly what, how much and where your actions are needed 
* Save costs and protect the environment by using precision farming techniques instead of a
  “shotgun” approach

[FS21 sensor]
[digital farming]

### How can I go from reactive to proactive actions?

By receiving warnings about crucial trends and data insights to prioritise essential next steps.

With Farm21 you can:
* Anticipate problems before they happen
* Act on trigger warnings based on  calculated thresholds

[Check Out the platform][42]

### How can Farm21 help me save time?

By helping users to quickly determine which actions are needed on a day-to-day basis and where to
deploy your workforce most effectively.

You can reduce labour and travel time for remote plots by prioritising the most important fields.

**With Farm21 you can:**
* Have 24/7 remote access to your fields
* Immediately see which fields need your attention 

[check out our sensors][43]
[farming]

### How can I cut resource and labour costs?

By deploying your resources only where they are needed.

With Farm21 you can:
* Save on crop protection, water and fuel inputs
* Cut labour costs by prioritising correctly

### How will Farm21 help me make fact-based decisions?

Through supporting your knowledge with consistent and accurate data. Our monitoring tools can be
applied globally, for real-time updates.

With Farm21 you can:
* Have a complete overview of what’s really happening in your fields
* Automatically gather consistent data to back up your field trial conclusions
* Discover the root cause of problems to take preventative measures
* Easily benchmark performance from season to season

[farm21]

* Help clients achieve higher yields and lower in-put costs
* Respond quicker and with an up-to-date overview of multiple fields
* Be the growers most valuable asset on the farm

* Identify data trends to support in-depth research

### How can I achieve higher yields?

By maintaining optimal growing conditions, whatever the crop, season, climate, or soil conditions.

With Farm21 you can:
* Predict possible problems 
* Prioritise actions
* Prevent crop stress
* Receive real-time field data 24/7

### How do I operate more sustainably without compromising on yield?

By making localised decisions about insects, fungi, water and cultivation and plan precisely for
labour and resources.

With Farm21 you can:
* Determine exactly what, how much and where your actions are needed 
* Save costs and protect the environment by using precision farming techniques instead of a
  “shotgun” approach

[FS21 sensor]
[digital farming]

### How can I go from reactive to proactive actions?

By receiving warnings about crucial trends and data insights to prioritise essential next steps.

With Farm21 you can:
* Anticipate problems before they happen
* Act on trigger warnings based on  calculated thresholds

[Check Out the platform][42]

### How can Farm21 help me save time?

By helping users to quickly determine which actions are needed on a day-to-day basis and where to
deploy your workforce most effectively.

You can reduce labour and travel time for remote plots by prioritising the most important fields.

**With Farm21 you can:**
* Have 24/7 remote access to your fields
* Immediately see which fields need your attention 

[check out our sensors][43]
[farming]

### How can I cut resource and labour costs?

By deploying your resources only where they are needed.

With Farm21 you can:
* Save on crop protection, water and fuel inputs
* Cut labour costs by prioritising correctly

### How will Farm21 help me make fact-based decisions?

Through supporting your knowledge with consistent and accurate data. Our monitoring tools can be
applied globally, for real-time updates.

With Farm21 you can:
* Have a complete overview of what’s really happening in your fields
* Automatically gather consistent data to back up your field trial conclusions
* Discover the root cause of problems to take preventative measures
* Easily benchmark performance from season to season

**The HW group company is a manufacturer of an RME (Remote Monitoring Ecosystem). **HW group
Thermometers are used for remote monitoring of data centers, vaccine freezers, technology rooms etc.
It’s also used for energy consumption metering.

•    Our products have a lifetime 5-15 years. Reliable remote monitoring & alerting.
•    Our customers are not buying just temperature probes.
•    Our customers are buying assurance that everything is OK in their remote location

**What we do is a reliable Ecosystem for B2B customers with hundreds of devices and sensors in one
project**. The whole system is Industrial-grade, secure, and proven. It starts with one temperature
sensor & ends with Voice-Call alert, PDF report, and graphs.

HW group company is based in Prague in the Czech Republic. Our portfolio now consists of more than
300 different product items and we distribute them globally with a network of 50 distributors, our
distribution network span Europe, the Middle East, and South & North America.

**[>> Read more about our company][27]**

### [Standalone Monitoring][33]

**Standalone** **Monitoring** products can be used independently (portal is not required). Devices
are sending emails, can be connected via SNMP to NMS (Network Monitoring System). Standalone
products are multi-purpose, device configuration is more complex and connecting the product to the
portal is only one of the functions. Using a central portal does not limit the sending of alarms
from the devices and other standalone functions.

[all products in category][34] ›

### [IP serial][35]

Many simple IT devices offer only a serial interface for local data handling and capture. With IP
serial converters, remote data capture and system control via Ethernet, both LAN and WAN networks,
can be easily implemented.

[all products in category][36] ›

### [Sensors][37]

The HW group product portfolio includes three major domains: Environmental, system and process
monitoring devices; technology for IP based serial interface system control and data logging and
Access Systems.

Temperature monitoring in refrigerators and storages where pharmaceuticals and temperature-sensitive

Efficient optimization and monitoring of energy consumption with our HWg-PWR device.

[more >][43]

Mobile Infrastructure needs reliable monitoring and alerting of cooling, heating and building/site
conditions.

[more >][45]
[Browse all solutions ›][46]

### [The HW group has launched the Perseus Industrial family with its first two units][47]

The Perseus Industrial family of monitoring devices for DIN-rail mount is now available.

### [HW group releases RTU-HTemp Display sensor][48]

HW group announces Modbus/RTU temperature and humidity sensor with LCD display.

Starting with version 2.2.3 SensDesk Technology portals offer two new features enhancing data

### [HW group is coming to the IIF Celjski sejem in Celje, Slovenia][50]

The HW group will be exhibiting at the IIF Celjski sejem in Slovenia from 14 to 17 April.

WLD-ECHO is a compact water leak detector for WLD-Sensing cables A/B (up to 185 m) with an audio

### [ime mobile solutions GmbH and HW group Deepen Their Partnership][52]

Long-standing exchange becomes official distribution: greater availability, faster projects,
comprehensive support.

Professional SNMP thermometer for remote environment monitoring.

Compact water leak detector for external sensing cables with an audible alarm and relay output,
powered by 2x AA batteries or 12 V DC.

### [Perseus Energy 242][55]

LAN solution in metal case for remote energy monitoring and control applications with M-Bus Master.

### [Perseus Monitoring 155][56]

Top-of-the-line LAN & LTE solution for any remote monitoring scenario.

### [Perseus Monitoring 150][57]

Top-of-the-line LAN solution for any remote monitoring scenario.

### [STE2 LITE][58]

Remote location temperature monitoring with email alerts.

### [WLD2][59]

WLD2 is a WiFi / Ethernet water leak detector with support for WWW, SNMP and PoE. To detect leaking
liquids, it uses 4 sensing cables

### [NB-2x1Wire][60]

4 external RJ11 sensors values to the portal (Temperature, Relative Humidity, Current, ...).
Internal battery, NB-IoT cellular network connectivity, portal required.

### [Ares 12 LTE][61]

Industrial measuring and monitoring for 14 sensors with GSM and LTE communication and back-up power.

### [STE2 R2][62]

WiFi and Ethernet, PoE available, temperature and humidity sensor with digital inputs. Up to 5
sensors of any RJ11 type.

### [Standalone Monitoring][33]

**Standalone** **Monitoring** products can be used independently (portal is not required). Devices
are sending emails, can be connected via SNMP to NMS (Network Monitoring System). Standalone
products are multi-purpose, device configuration is more complex and connecting the product to the
portal is only one of the functions. Using a central portal does not limit the sending of alarms
from the devices and other standalone functions.

serial converters, remote data capture and system control via Ethernet, both LAN and WAN networks,
can be easily implemented.

# ioX-Connect™

### **Comprehensive Hardware and Software Solutions for IoT, Asset Management, and Enhanced
### Maintenance**

[ Solutions Catalog Download ][49]
[IoT Platform]

## Innovative Asset Management and Monitoring Solutions

Dive into the world of ioX-Connect, your all-in-one platform for IoT, Asset Monitoring, and Advanced
Maintenance. Seamlessly gather data from sensors located anywhere on the planet, transform this raw
data into actionable insights with comprehensive analysis tools, and always stay ahead with our
robust asset performance management features. Whether you're looking for proactive planning tools or
the right sensors for unique challenges, ioX-Connect integrates it all into a single, powerful
package.

Say goodbye to scattered systems and hello to a unified, future-ready solution.

 

[ Speak to an Iot Specialist ][50]
[[LoRaWAN Devices and Platform | ioX-Connect]][51]

## **Turn IoT Data Into Actionable Intelligence**

The ioX-Connect IoT Platform is a cloud-based software solution designed to give businesses complete
visibility and control over their connected assets. From device onboarding and remote monitoring to
advanced analytics and predictive maintenance, ioX-Connect brings all your IoT data into one
intuitive platform. With real-time dashboards, automated alerts, and seamless integrations, the
platform empowers organizations to reduce downtime, optimize operations, and make data-driven
decisions. Built to be secure, scalable, and hardware-agnostic, ioX-Connect is the foundation for
transforming sensor data into actionable business intelligence across any industry.

 

[ Learn More about our IoT Platform ][52]

## ioX-CMMS

Crafting a [CMMS][53] that's not only easy to use but also integrates advanced IoT capabilities and
smoothly manages intricate work processes is no small feat. Our experience has taught us that
companies utilize [CMMS][54] solutions in diverse ways. With this knowledge, [ioX-CMMS][55] has been
meticulously designed to meet such varied needs.

 

[ Learn more about ioX-CMMS ][56]
[[CMMS Multiple Devices]][57]
[[Analytics - Production Analysis]][58]

[Harness the potential of your IoT and Maintenance data][59] with our innovative ioX-Analysis™
widgets and interactive dashboards, expertly crafted to breathe life into your insights.

 

[ Learn more about our Analytics Solution ][60]
Your Data Starts at the Source

10 + mi

Line-of-sight LoRaWAN range for campus-wide, rural, and multi-building deployments

Battery life engineered for install-and-forget operation, even in harsh environments

120 +

Sensor types spanning temperature, pressure, moisture, vibration, air quality, water leak, and more

5 mins

From unboxing to live data on your ioX-Connect dashboard

## SOBRE NOSOTROS

Itokii es una nueva propuesta de Inicius LLC. 


Proporcionamos una forma sencilla de conectar Cosas a Internet con fines operativos y de
supervisión.

¿Cómo? Uso de sensores, puertas de enlace, portales web y aplicaciones móviles fáciles de conectar.


Después de algunos meses trabajando junto con IT builders, proveedores, amigos, clientes
potenciales, desarrolladores de software y diseñadores, decidimos lanzar una solución para facilitar
la adopción del Internet de las cosas en los segmentos de mercado comercial e industrial.


Queremos ayudar a organizations a digitalizar su negocio.


Inicius fue fundada en Miami, Florida en noviembre de 2016 por un grupo de personas con experiencia
comprobada en IoT y Business Process.  Con un enfoque en el sur de América del Norte y
Latinoamérica, creamos una organización de bajo costo para entregar nuestros productos y servicios
lo más rápido posible ofreciendo una solución de valor agregado con precios competitivos.


Itokii es propiedad de Inicius LLC, Miami, Florida, EEUU. Todos los derechos reservados 2016-2024.

### Poné tus tareas en Piloto Automático

# Si lo haces más de tres veces, lo podemos automatizar. Creamos "puentes invisibles" entre tus
# aplicaciones para que la información fluya sola.

Detectamos juntos las tareas que se repiten

Las configuramos en herramientas de automatización

Las supervisas , auditas y generamos mejoras en el proceso

# We reshape the world of sensors

Knitronix specializes in producing flexible distributed sensors using proprietary smart fabrics. Our
innovative textile sensors are engineered to reliably detect **tactile pressure,
temperature,moisture and the presence of liquids, deformation.**
What sets Knitronix apart is our sensor technology's unique combination of benefits: easily adapt to
complex shapes, resistant to mechanical fatigue, monitor large surfaces affordably, fully
breathable.
Manufactured with **industrial-grade
expertise, every Knitronix sensor is designed for global integration. When you embed our technology
into your product, you can ship it worldwide with confidence, knowing the sensor's performance and
reliability are assured.

# Your **Smart Building Technology Partner** from Concept to Delivery

First and foremost we’re client-centric, we talk your language and our team supports you with
product distribution, technical advice, project support and industry-leading training – helping you
design, deploy and maintain high-performing Niagara-based Smart Building solutions with confidence.

#### **Everything Niagara IoT, Expertly Supported**

We offer the widest range of Niagara-compatible products available on the market. From embedded IoT
and BMS Control devices to specialist drivers and integration tools.

[View Niagara Offerings][75]

#### **LoRaWAN Distribution, Training & Integration**

Your LoRaWAN partner for every project, we distribute the world’s leading Gateways and Sensors, and
offer exclusive 1-day Training and Integration Consultancy.

[Explore LoRaWAN Solutions][76]

#### **The World’s Leading Multi BCIA Award-winning Training Provider**

Get Tridium Certified with our world-renowned training course. From beginner to master Niagara
integrator, we have courses across IoT, LoRaWAN, Networks, Security and more.

[View Our Training Courses][77]

#### **Master System Integrator Development & Project Consultancy**

Our award-winning MSI experience means we are best-placed to help with your projects, in-tandem with
providing SI’s with the skills and training to become a leading MSI.

[Explore the MSI Skillset][78]

#### **UK & Worldwide Distribution**

**From decades of experience working with the world’s leading manufacturers, we’ve created a
portfolio of solutions that satisfy every smart building project requirement, exclusively enhanced
by our in-house software development team with integration drivers and productivity graphics**

# LoRaWAN Solutions from Start to Finish

#### **Your global distribution, integration and training partner for every project**

**We combine expertise and experience in LoRaWAN and Niagara 4 to help you design and deploy
connected building solutions. From network design and device selection to seamless Niagara
integration of IAQ, Energy Monitoring, Occupancy and more**

### **LoRaWAN Gateways**

The world’s leading gateways from Milesight, Wattsense & Veea

# Multi BCIA-Award Winning Training Provider

#### **From beginner to Master Niagara Integrator, we have a course for you**

**Our globally recognised, multi-BCIA award-winning Tridium Certification and Niagara IoT
masterclasses help integrators and engineers build the skills needed to deliver the industry best
smart building projects**

### **Niagara & BAS Intro**

New to BMS? We offer BAS Foundations and Niagara 101

# Award Winning MSI & Enablement Services

#### **We help turn complex and disparate building systems into an intelligently connected
#### all-encompassing solution**

**By acting as an independent technical authority, the MSI removes silos between vendors, simplifies
delivery and handover, and enables smart, efficient buildings that perform from day one and adapt
for the future.**

### **Explore the MSI Role with One Sight**

We help clients with Big Data, IT Networks, BIM, BMS and Cloud Integration

From Design to Deployment, we have the expertise to help deliver award-winning integrations for
Energy Efficiency, Occupant Wellbeing and Operational use cases.

A New Platform for better Smart Enablement through Time-saving and Risk Reduction

# **OSS Drivers for Tridium** Niagara 4/5

#### **We help you simplify integration, boost engineering productivity, and accelerate project
#### delivery**

**Developed from years of experience, our 11x Niagara Drivers help you to Stop Fighting the Clock
and Skillset Gaps, all whilst Maximising Project ROI and Niagara Efficiency**

We recognise Tridium Niagara 4 as the gold standard for Smart Building integration, but today’s
projects demand more than just a BMS. Clients expect seamless API integration, scalable IoT
connectivity, and automated reporting. These aren’t limitations – they’re opportunities to maximise
the value of Niagara even further to delivery the best projects.

[Get Your Free Trial of All 11x Drivers Now][79]

### **We’re at the forefront of the most demanding building industry
### **

#### **Making buildings smarter through automated energy management, occupant wellbeing and
#### environmental sustainability**


### **Our Expertise and Experience
### **

Formed in 2008, we strive to meet the demands of UK System Houses, Building Owners, Managers,
Consultants and Occupants by providing open source solutions that communicate with all building
systems.

The Niagara Framework is a forward-thinking integration method that provides an all-inclusive
overview of a buildings performance, which assists in optimising and controlling the smart
technology within to improve energy consumption, reduce operational costs and improve occupant
wellbeing.

Our extensive experience working with the Niagara Framework across BMS and IoT, Product Selection
and our own in-house expert IT Developers, make us best placed in the market to deliver complete
solutions to our customers and their integration projects.

#### **Embracing technology with open communication protocols means System Integrators can adapt to
#### every project scenario**


### **Hardware & Software for Quality Integrations
### **

As a Tridium Platinum Distributor, we stock the widest range of Niagara compatible hardware and
software on the market. Our vast industry experience for product selection, technical support and
customer service has resulted in us having a solution for virtually every use case.
Our in-house team of industry leading software developers expand integration possibilities and
improve productivity through our exlusive software tools. Niagara drivers, LoRaWAN and IoT sensor
solutions, Site Surveys, Data & Cloud Integration and IT Infrastructure.
From our involvement within Smart Building integrations and MSI role, we understand how clients can
maximise their buildings potential. Our Tridium courses across certifications, security, networks,
advanced IoT integration and MSI training set the bar for the industry.

## Built to Connect.
## Designed to Scale.

The M25 is the hub of a secure, flexible ecosystem—connecting seamlessly to sensors, access modules,
cameras, and mobile control via BlueEye. Whether you’re deploying a simple residential setup or a
full-scale commercial system, the M25 grows with your needs.

[ View System Diagram ][46]

### Direct Monitoring

No cloud required.

Secure, always-on IP supervision to receivers.

### Reliable Connectivity

Triple-channel failover with PoE, Wi-Fi, and built-in LTE.

### Mobile Control

Full system access through

 the intuitive BlueEye app.

### Quick Setup

Auto-learn devices instantly with QR scan or serial input.

### OTA Updates

Remote firmware upgrades keep your system current.

### Modular Design

Scales to 100 zones, 

128 users. Fully expandable and future-ready.

## System Highlights

## How It Works

See how installation, communication, and control come together in one secure system.

### Step 1:
### Connect

Power up the M25 using a single PoE Ethernet cable — no extra wiring or power supply needed.

### Step 2:
### Pair & Learn

Auto-learn wireless and Ethernet devices using QR scan or serial input. Pre-install remotely or
on-site in minutes.

### Step 3:
### Expand and control

Add and manage detectors, video, and access devices with full supervision and OTA support.

### Step 4:
### Customize Update & Final Setup

Set users, logic, and schedules, then update firmware and complete system setup.

## Built to Connect.
## Designed to Scale.

The M25 is the hub of a secure, flexible ecosystem—connecting seamlessly to sensors, access modules,
cameras, and mobile control via BlueEye. Whether you’re deploying a simple residential setup or a
full-scale commercial system, the M25 grows with your needs.

[ View System Diagram ][46]

### Direct Monitoring

No cloud required.

Secure, always-on IP supervision to receivers.

### Reliable Connectivity

Triple-channel failover with PoE, Wi-Fi, and built-in LTE.

### Mobile Control

Full system access through

 the intuitive BlueEye app.

### Quick Setup

Auto-learn devices instantly with QR scan or serial input.

### OTA Updates

Remote firmware upgrades keep your system current.

### Modular Design

Scales to 100 zones, 

128 users. Fully expandable and future-ready.

## System Highlights

## How It Works

See how installation, communication, and control come together in one secure system.

### Step 1:
### Connect

Power up the M25 using a single PoE Ethernet cable — no extra wiring or power supply needed.

### Step 2:
### Pair & Learn

Auto-learn wireless and Ethernet devices using QR scan or serial input. Pre-install remotely or
on-site in minutes.

### Step 3:
### Expand and control

Add and manage detectors, video, and access devices with full supervision and OTA support.

### Step 4:
### Customize Update & Final Setup

Set users, logic, and schedules, then update firmware and complete system setup.

#### Use cases

## Key features

Explore the unparalleled efficiency of our systems in action, directly where it matters most – out
in the field. Our cutting-edge technology is designed to withstand the rigors of real-world
application, proving its reliability and effectiveness in various environments. Discover firsthand
how our solutions are transforming operations, enhancing performance, and driving success across
industries. Join us on a journey to see our innovative systems in action, demonstrating their
capabilities and how they excel in delivering results beyond expectations.

[icon_dark_cloud-alarm]

#### Cloud-based alarms

Harness our wireless alarms across a range of different use cases, including water treatment plants
and facilities monitoring. Our products have even been used to monitor temperature changes and AC
functions in Times Square billboards!

[icon_dark_cloud-device]

#### Cloud-based SCADA

Take advantage of cloud-based SCADA enhancements with our AlarmAgent.com® product. This allows you
to gather real-time data visualizations of your facility ecosystem, all from your preferred
dashboards and screens. 

[icon_dark_autodialer]

#### Landline autodialer

Our cellular autodialer alarm systems are fit for monitoring critical environments, such as sewage
plants. The system tracks power failure and sewage wet well levels without anyone present. When
conditions are met, the system calls for help. 

[icon_dark_alarm]

#### PLC integrated alarms

Add monitoring and alarms to existing SCADA systems. Support for multiple protocols and PLC types.
Even integrate across different PLC technologies. Gather important data for your teams, as well as a
history of alarm responses, and avoid catastrophe with a proactive approach.

#### Cloud-based alarms

Harness our wireless alarms across a range of different use cases, including water treatment plants
and facilities monitoring. Our products have even been used to monitor temperature changes and AC
functions in Times Square billboards!

[icon_dark_cloud-device]

#### Cloud-based SCADA

Take advantage of cloud-based SCADA enhancements with our AlarmAgent.com® product. This allows you
to gather real-time data visualizations of your facility ecosystem, all from your preferred
dashboards and screens. 

[icon_dark_autodialer]

#### Landline autodialer

Our cellular autodialer alarm systems are fit for monitoring critical environments, such as sewage
plants. The system tracks power failure and sewage wet well levels without anyone present. When
conditions are met, the system calls for help. 

[icon_dark_alarm]

#### PLC integrated alarms

Add monitoring and alarms to existing SCADA systems. Support for multiple protocols and PLC types.
Even integrate across different PLC technologies. Gather important data for your teams, as well as a
history of alarm responses, and avoid catastrophe with a proactive approach.

## ABOUT Rika Sensor

Hunan Rika Electronic Tech Co., Ltd, located in Changsha, is a privately held weather sensor
manufacturer and solution provider of environmental & weather monitoring for 15+ years. 

 

Rika Sensor is committed to developing and providing intelligent and cost-effective IoT
environmental monitoring products and services, including: wind measurement, solar radiation
measurement, weather sensors, temperature and humidity measurement, hydro-meteorological
measurement, soil moisture measurement, water quality measurement, ICT liquid cooling water quality
monitoring, data loggers, environmental sensors and various weather stations and meteorological
monitoring stations.

 

All products are CE and RoHS certified, and have been widely deployed across supercomputing centers,
ICT liquid cooling systems, solar energy, smart agriculture, aquaculture, sewage treatment, air
quality monitoring, wind power generation and other meteorological and environmental monitoring
fields. The company holds full international management system certifications: ISO9001 (Quality
Management), ISO14001 (Environmental Management), ISO45001 (Occupational Health & Safety) and TUV.

# Eliminate Water Waste at Scale

## We help commercial real-estate owners lower operating costs, protect their properties, and
## increase sustainability with water technology

[Book Demo][22]

## **Proactive Water Intelligence**

Our solutions proactively detect catastrophic leaks and rescue unseen water waste from toilet leaks
by monitoring and reporting in real-time.

Centralized Dashboard

Sensor technology includes:
* Sensors with custom installation
* Monitoring, alerts and access to water experts
* Central management and reporting

## Water Leak Solution
* Proactively detect leaks to avoid water damage to multiple floors
* Preserve your maintenance budget
* Avoid higher insurance premiums

## Toilet Leak Solution
* 5-20% of apartment toilets are leaking, wasting up to 5,000 gallons per day
* Rest assured with real-time monitoring, alerts and reporting
* Save water to make an environmental impact and support ESG goals

## Submeter Solution
* Precise measurement of cold and hot water in various settings
* Static flow technology eliminates wear and tear for long-term reliability
* Seamless integration with AMR systems via built-in LoRaWAN communication

## Shut Off Valve Solution
* Battery-operated wireless valve compatible with LoRaWAN open protocol networks with ultra-low
  power consumption
* Remote open/close operations
* Exceptional indoor signal penetration, even over extreme long distances

Good for Business and the Planet
Higher net operating income from lower water and sewer bills, reduced insurance premiums, and lower
leak remediation costs while saving water. Our water know-how helps multi-unit dwelling operators
benefit from sensor technology at scale.

# Eliminate Water Waste at Scale

## We help commercial real-estate owners lower operating costs, protect their properties, and
## increase sustainability with water technology

[Book Demo][22]

## **Proactive Water Intelligence**

Our solutions proactively detect catastrophic leaks and rescue unseen water waste from toilet leaks
by monitoring and reporting in real-time.

Centralized Dashboard

Sensor technology includes:
* Sensors with custom installation
* Monitoring, alerts and access to water experts
* Central management and reporting

## Water Leak Solution
* Proactively detect leaks to avoid water damage to multiple floors
* Preserve your maintenance budget
* Avoid higher insurance premiums

## Toilet Leak Solution
* 5-20% of apartment toilets are leaking, wasting up to 5,000 gallons per day
* Rest assured with real-time monitoring, alerts and reporting
* Save water to make an environmental impact and support ESG goals

## Submeter Solution
* Precise measurement of cold and hot water in various settings
* Static flow technology eliminates wear and tear for long-term reliability
* Seamless integration with AMR systems via built-in LoRaWAN communication

## Shut Off Valve Solution
* Battery-operated wireless valve compatible with LoRaWAN open protocol networks with ultra-low
  power consumption
* Remote open/close operations
* Exceptional indoor signal penetration, even over extreme long distances

Good for Business and the Planet
Higher net operating income from lower water and sewer bills, reduced insurance premiums, and lower
leak remediation costs while saving water. Our water know-how helps multi-unit dwelling operators
benefit from sensor technology at scale.

[Affordable Housing][23] | [Apartments][24] | [Hotels][25] | [Senior Living][26] | [Student
Housing][27]

# Wireless Sensors for Remote Monitoring

#### Real-time analytics, alerts, and reports

Swift Sensors helps customers make data-driven decisions in mission-critical moments. Its
high-performing, comprehensive wireless sensor solutions are always on, reliably measuring and
remotely monitoring customers’ most valuable can’t-fail assets. Swift Sensors delivers a seamless,
automated, high-quality experience that combines best-in-class and cost-effective cloud-based
monitoring solutions with unmatched expert support.

### Remote Monitoring

device.

Swift Sensors offers an innovative suite of wireless sensor solutions designed for a wide variety of
applications, each aimed at enhancing operational efficiency, safety, and business performance.

[Featured Wireless Sensor Applications]

#### Refrigeration Monitoring

Swift Sensors refrigeration monitoring technology ensures the integrity and longevity of perishable
goods by providing real-time temperature and humidity data.

[ Refrigeration Monitoring ][59]

#### Indoor Air Quality

The Swift Sensors Indoor Air Quality Sensor supports human health and comfort by continuously
monitoring the conditions of the air inside buildings.

[ Indoor Air Quality ][60]

#### Water Leak Detection

Swift Sensors water detection technology provides immediate alerts on leaks or flooding, protecting
infrastructure from potential water damage.

[ Water Detection ][61]

#### Utility Management

The Rhino utility monitoring solution from Swift Sensors offers actionable insights into utility
consumption, enabling efficient energy use and cost savings.

[ Energy Consumption ][62]

## Protect Your Business & Your Reputation

Swift Sensors is an easy-to-deploy, scalable monitoring and alerts solution driven by wireless smart
sensors. Send instant alerts via email, SMS, or phone call for events that require immediate
corrective action. Protect your business and your reputation from avoidable downtime, loss of
assets, and preventable regulatory challenges.

## Common Industries We Serve

Swift Sensors advanced remote monitoring and alert solutions support varied industries, ensuring
operational efficiency, inventory integrity, safe working conditions, and regulatory compliance.
From medical labs, hospitals, and schools to industrial manufacturing, food processing, and
restaurants, our technology supports the critical needs of diverse sectors.

### Medical Labs

Swift Sensors supports precise environmental control and temperature monitoring, critical for sample
integrity, product efficacy, and research accuracy.

distribution facilities with no disruption to daily operations.

### Restaurants
